items.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
items.description: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.
items.title_vi: Stripe không thực sự mua OpenRouter vì 'điểm kỳ dị'
items.title_en: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
items.summary_vi: Gã khổng lồ thanh toán muốn gì với một công ty khởi nghiệp định tuyến lời nhắc giữa các mô hình AI khác nhau? Stripe nói rằng đó là vì "điểm kỳ dị" nhưng thực ra là vì một lý do thực tế và mạnh mẽ hơn nhiều.
items.summary_en: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

items.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
items.description: The next-generation robotaxi, called the Waymo Ojai, is central to the company's push towards mass scale, and eventually, profitability.
